title: The Shelf of Returns

scene_arrivals.narration: The Exchange keeps a shelf for things the sea brings back. This morning the air above it has torn open, and cold wind blows out of the tear.

scene_tear.narration: Snow drifts out of the tear and settles on the shelf. Somewhere on the other side, ice is creaking.
